sentences.en: But as fun as they can be, personality tests can also lead to serious outcomes.
sentences.zh: 但尽管性格测试很有趣，它们也可能导致严重的后果。

sentences.en: Many corporations today are using such tests to make important decisions.
sentences.zh: 如今许多公司都在利用这些测试来做出重要决策。

sentences.en: When we asked listeners to share their experiences of personality testing in the workplace,
sentences.zh: 当我们邀请听众分享他们在职场中进行性格测试的经历时，

sentences.en: we got a huge response.
sentences.zh: 我们收到了巨大的反响。

sentences.en: The most famous of these workplace personality tests is the Myers-Briggs Type Indicator, or the MBTI.
sentences.zh: 这些职场性格测试中最著名的是迈尔斯-布里格斯类型指标，即MBTI。

sentences.en: It sorts people into 16 personality types, and it's hugely popular.
sentences.zh: 它将人分为16种性格类型，非常受欢迎。

sentences.en: It's used by most of America's Fortune 100 companies,
sentences.zh: 美国大多数财富100强公司都在使用它，

sentences.en: and some 2 million people take the test each year.
sentences.zh: 每年约有200万人参加这项测试。

sentences.en: The test categorizes you along four axes.
sentences.zh: 该测试根据四个维度对你进行分类。

sentences.en: Each describes a way of seeing or dealing with the world.
sentences.zh: 每个维度都描述了一种看待或处理世界的方式。

sentences.en: For example, if you're an ENFP, that means you're an extrovert rather than an introvert.
sentences.zh: 例如，如果你是ENFP，这意味着你更倾向于外向而非内向。

sentences.en: You rely on intuition more than facts.
sentences.zh: 你更依赖直觉而非事实。

sentences.en: You're emotional rather than cerebral.
sentences.zh: 你更感性而非理性。

sentences.en: And you prefer to go with the flow rather than have a highly structured life.
sentences.zh: 你更喜欢随遇而安，而不是过着高度结构化的生活。

sentences.en: We had lots of people call in about the Myers-Briggs.
sentences.zh: 我们接到了很多关于迈尔斯-布里格斯的听众来电。

sentences.en: Many praised the test for helping to improve their lives.
sentences.zh: 许多人称赞该测试帮助改善了他们的生活。

sentences.en: Some said it helped them find love.
sentences.zh: 有些人说它帮助他们找到了爱情。

sentences.en: I took the personality test as part of a Christian club that I was in as an undergraduate in college
sentences.zh: 我在大学本科时参加了一个基督教社团，作为社团活动的一部分，我做了这个性格测试，

sentences.en: and discovered that I am what Myers-Briggs calls an ENFP.
sentences.zh: 发现自己就是迈尔斯-布里格斯所说的ENFP。

sentences.en: This is listener Haley Jones.
sentences.zh: 这是听众海莉·琼斯。

sentences.en: She says she didn't think much about her Myers-Briggs category until she made a discovery.
sentences.zh: 她说在做出一个发现之前，她并没有太在意自己的迈尔斯-布里格斯类别。

sentences.en: The last three guys who I dated had all had the same Myers-Briggs type indicator.
sentences.zh: 我过去交往的最后三个男人，他们的迈尔斯-布里格斯类型指标竟然完全一样。

sentences.en: They were all INTJs.
sentences.zh: 他们都是INTJ。

sentences.en: Once she realized this, she began to use this pattern as a screening tool.
sentences.zh: 一旦意识到这一点，她就开始把这种模式当作一种筛选工具。

sentences.en: And I absolutely looked for them.
sentences.zh: 我绝对会去寻找他们。

sentences.en: It's one of the first questions I ask people.
sentences.zh: 这是我问别人的第一个问题之一。

sentences.en: And on all my dating profiles, it says ENFP seeks INTJ.
sentences.zh: 而且我所有的约会资料上都写着：ENFP寻找INTJ。

sentences.en: And I know that that sounds kind of funny.
sentences.zh: 我知道这听起来有点好笑。

sentences.en: But it's just been true for me.
sentences.zh: 但这对我来说确实是真的。

sentences.en: Ali Adler took the Myers-Briggs during a hard time in her career.
sentences.zh: 阿里·阿德勒在职业生涯的困难时期参加了迈尔斯-布里格斯测试。

sentences.en: She was 26 and miserable in her job.
sentences.zh: 那时她26岁，对工作感到非常痛苦。

sentences.en: The test told her that she was an ENFJ.
sentences.zh: 测试结果显示她是ENFJ。

sentences.en: This was a surprise because Ali didn't think of herself as driven by emotion.
sentences.zh: 这很令人惊讶，因为阿里并不认为自己是一个受情感驱动的人。

sentences.en: But she soon began to see things about herself that told her the test was right.
sentences.zh: 但她很快开始发现自己身上的一些特质，这些特质告诉她测试是正确的。

sentences.en: And it really helped me understand myself in a way that I hadn't understood myself before
sentences.zh: 它确实帮助我以一种以前从未有过的方式了解了自己，

sentences.en: so that I could work around and manage challenges both in my personal and my professional life
sentences.zh: 这样我就能处理和管理个人生活和职业生涯中的挑战，

sentences.en: related to the emotionally feelings-driven person and part of my personality
sentences.zh: 这些挑战与我性格中感性、受情感驱动的部分有关，

sentences.en: that I hadn't really acknowledged before and it turns out is really central to who I am.
sentences.zh: 我以前从未真正承认过这一点，但事实证明，这确实是我性格的核心。

sentences.en: So learning about my personality type has actually been, I think, critical to my happiness and
sentences.zh: 所以，了解我的性格类型实际上对我之后的幸福和

sentences.en: my success since then.
sentences.zh: 成功至关重要。

sentences.en: And I am really glad I did it.
sentences.zh: 我真的很高兴我做了这个测试。

sentences.en: Some listeners said their test results had even shaped their very identity.
sentences.zh: 一些听众说，他们的测试结果甚至塑造了他们的自我认同。

sentences.en: In college, my best friend and I both took the Myers-Briggs personality teSt.
sentences.zh: 在大学里，我和我最好的朋友都做了迈尔斯-布里格斯性格测试。

sentences.en: And we both wound up getting ENFP.
sentences.zh: 结果我们俩最后都是ENFP。

sentences.en: This is Christina Healy.
sentences.zh: 这是克里斯蒂娜·希利。

sentences.en: And we both were just so excited about it.
sentences.zh: 我们俩当时都非常兴奋。

sentences.en: We read the description of what that meant for us and the types of job we were most likely
sentences.zh: 我们阅读了关于这意味着什么的描述，以及我们最有可能从事的工作类型，

sentences.en: to get and just different personality traits.
sentences.zh: 还有各种不同的性格特征。

sentences.en: And that really helped solidify a lot of our personality during that time.
sentences.zh: 那确实在当时帮助巩固了我们许多的性格特质。

sentences.en: Christina says those last years of college were an important time of self-discovery.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜说，大学的最后几年是自我发现的重要时期。

sentences.en: I mean, that did a lot of the hard work for us, being able to just read and agree with
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，它为我们做了很多艰苦的工作，只要读一读并表示认同，

sentences.en: and then therefore live the rest of our lives that way.
sentences.zh: 然后就按照那种方式去过余生。

sentences.en: What Christina is saying is that the test played the role that a friend or a teacher
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜的意思是，这个测试扮演了朋友、老师

sentences.en: or a mentor might have played.
sentences.zh: 或导师可能扮演的角色。

sentences.en: The test told her, Christina, this is who you are.
sentences.zh: 测试告诉她：克里斯蒂娜，这就是你。

sentences.en: This is your destiny.
sentences.zh: 这就是你的命运。

sentences.en: She had a mold and she was happy to shape herself to it.
sentences.zh: 她有了一个模子，并且很高兴按照这个模子来塑造自己。

sentences.en: Years later, Christina was asked to take the test again.
sentences.zh: 多年后，克里斯蒂娜被要求再次参加测试。

sentences.en: A lot had happened in her life since she and her roommate learned that they were both ENFPs.
sentences.zh: 自从她和室友得知她们都是ENFP以来，她的生活中发生了很多事。

sentences.en: She'd gone to graduate school, relocated to a new city, matured.
sentences.zh: 她读了研究生，搬到了新城市，也成熟了。

sentences.en: She'd changed and she worried her Myers-Briggs category would change too.
sentences.zh: 她变了，她担心自己的迈尔斯-布里格斯类别也会改变。

sentences.en: She didn't want that.
sentences.zh: 她不想那样。

sentences.en: So when she retook the test, she made sure to give answers that would allow her to remain an ENFP.
sentences.zh: 所以当她重做测试时，她确保给出的答案能让她保持ENFP的身份。

sentences.en: She'd found her tribe.
sentences.zh: 她找到了自己的群体。

sentences.en: She didn't want to be kicked out.
sentences.zh: 她不想被踢出去。

sentences.en: For all those who love the Myers-Briggs and other personality tests, there are plenty of people who don't.
sentences.zh: 对于所有热爱迈尔斯-布里格斯和其他性格测试的人来说，也有很多人并不喜欢它们。

sentences.en: They feel that rather than helping, these tests can be deeply destructive.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得这些测试不仅没有帮助，反而可能具有极大的破坏性。

sentences.en: And I started feeling like Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde, like there was this person that would come out and I had no idea that it was there.
sentences.zh: 我开始觉得自己像杰基尔博士和海德先生，好像有一个我完全不知道的人格冒了出来。

sentences.en: When we come back, we look at how personality tests are being used for more than dating advice and career counseling.
sentences.zh: 回来后，我们将探讨性格测试如何被用于约会建议和职业咨询之外的领域。

sentences.en: Increasingly, they've turned into a tool to decide who should do what in the workplace, who should get a promotion, who should get fired.
sentences.zh: 它们越来越多地成为决定职场中谁该做什么、谁该升职、谁该被解雇的工具。

sentences.en: You're listening to Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 你正在收听的是《隐藏的大脑》（Hidden Brain）。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantam.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·维丹塔姆。

sentences.en: Stay with us.
sentences.zh: 请继续收听。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantam.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·维丹塔姆。

sentences.en: You're listening to Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 你正在收听的是《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: Today we're talking about the power of personality tests.
sentences.zh: 今天我们讨论的是性格测试的力量。

sentences.en: These tools tap into a deep desire we have to discover our place in the world.
sentences.zh: 这些工具触及了我们内心深处想要发现自己在世界上位置的渴望。

sentences.en: For some people, they offer comfort and relief.
sentences.zh: 对一些人来说，它们提供了安慰和解脱。

sentences.en: But that's not always the case.
sentences.zh: 但情况并非总是如此。

sentences.en: Hello, Hidden Brain friends.
sentences.zh: 你好，《隐藏的大脑》的朋友们。

sentences.en: My name is Matthew.
sentences.zh: 我叫马修。

sentences.en: I am in Westminster, Colorado.
sentences.zh: 我在科罗拉多州的威斯敏斯特。

sentences.en: And my experience with Myers-Briggs played no small part in destroying my life, ruining me emotionally for years.
sentences.zh: 我对迈尔斯-布里格斯的经历在摧毁我的生活、在情感上折磨我多年方面起了不小的作用。

sentences.en: Matthew Gale says that after being promoted to technical director at a theater he worked at, he and other managers went on an overnight retreat.
sentences.zh: 马修·盖尔说，在被提升为他工作的剧院的技术总监后，他和经理们参加了一次过夜的静修活动。

sentences.en: Among other team-building activities, they all took to Myers-Briggs.
sentences.zh: 在其他团队建设活动中，他们都做了迈尔斯-布里格斯测试。

sentences.en: And now my job required that I be organized and have ideas and do math and all these sort of technical and intellectual things.
sentences.zh: 现在我的工作要求我必须有条理、有想法、会算术，还要做各种技术和智力方面的事情。

sentences.en: And when we did the Myers-Briggs, I came out to be like this INFJ.
sentences.zh: 当我们做迈尔斯-布里格斯测试时，我的结果是INFJ。

sentences.en: I was mystic and quiet.
sentences.zh: 我是神秘而安静的。

sentences.en: And so after that, after that moment, anytime I made a mistake or I said something or had an idea, either my coworkers or myself would say,
sentences.zh: 所以在那之后，在那一刻之后，每当我犯错、说错话或提出一个想法时，我的同事或我自己就会说，

sentences.en: but that's just because you're this personality type.
sentences.zh: “那只是因为你是这种性格类型。”

sentences.en: Maybe there's a job better suited to your personality type.
sentences.zh: “也许有更适合你性格类型的工作。”

sentences.en: And it made it so people didn't trust my opinion, didn't trust my ideas, didn't trust my conclusion, didn't trust any action that I took throughout the day.
sentences.zh: 这导致人们不再信任我的意见、想法、结论，也不再信任我全天采取的任何行动。

sentences.en: Matthew began to doubt his own skills.
sentences.zh: 马修开始怀疑自己的能力。

sentences.en: I thought I was this sort of organized and logical person, and I started feeling like Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde, like there was this person that would come out,
sentences.zh: 我以为自己是一个有条理、有逻辑的人，但我开始觉得自己像杰基尔博士和海德先生，好像有一个我完全不知道的人格冒了出来，

sentences.en: and I had no idea that it was there.
sentences.zh: 而我根本不知道它的存在。

sentences.en: That I was really this artsy-fartsy, head-in-the-clouds guy who couldn't get anything done, who really just needed to have a pottery studio and sit around and smoke pot all day.
sentences.zh: 我真的成了那种艺术气息浓厚、整天异想天开、什么事都做不成的人，那种真的只需要有一个陶艺工作室，整天坐在那里抽大麻的人。

sentences.en: That's kind of how people were treating me.
sentences.zh: 人们就是这样对待我的。

sentences.en: Matthew says his colleagues stopped trusting him, and he stopped trusting himself.
sentences.zh: 马修说他的同事不再信任他，他也开始不再信任自己。

sentences.en: A veterinarian I spoke with also felt that the personality test she took at work had gotten her completely wrong.
sentences.zh: 我采访过的一位兽医也觉得她在工作中做的性格测试完全误解了她。

sentences.en: Cynthia works for a private animal emergency hotline.
sentences.zh: 辛西娅为一家私人动物紧急热线工作。

sentences.en: We're not using her last name or the name of her company to protect her privacy.
sentences.zh: 为了保护隐私，我们不使用她的姓氏或她公司的名称。

sentences.en: Cynthia says her job is very stressful.
sentences.zh: 辛西娅说她的工作压力很大。

sentences.en: Often people call in panicked.
sentences.zh: 人们打电话来时往往很恐慌。

sentences.en: She remembers one call from a person whose Labrador retriever had eaten rat poison.
sentences.zh: 她记得有一个人打来电话，说他的拉布拉多犬吃了老鼠药。

sentences.en: The owner was really, really anxious.
sentences.zh: 主人当时非常、非常焦虑。

sentences.en: The dog had just gotten into it five minutes earlier.
sentences.zh: 狗是在五分钟前刚吃下去的。

sentences.en: And when they're really anxious, they say, usually at the end, is my dog going to die?
sentences.zh: 当他们非常焦虑时，通常最后会问：“我的狗会死吗？”

sentences.en: Often, Cynthia takes 30 calls like this from around the country in an eight-hour shift.
sentences.zh: 辛西娅在八小时的轮班中，经常要接听30个这样的全国来电。

sentences.en: It's work that requires a combination of knowledge and patience and empathy.
sentences.zh: 这份工作需要知识、耐心和同理心的结合。

sentences.en: Cynthia and her colleagues rely on one another for support.
sentences.zh: 辛西娅和她的同事们互相依靠，提供支持。

sentences.en: We're all very conscientious of each other.
sentences.zh: 我们都非常体谅彼此。

sentences.en: We have a good group there.
sentences.zh: 我们那里有一个很好的团队。

sentences.en: We don't have any scheduled breaks when we're at work.
sentences.zh: 我们在工作时没有固定的休息时间。

sentences.en: We only take breaks when it's not too busy and the other person isn't going to be swamped by too many calls.
sentences.zh: 我们只在不那么忙、且其他人不会被过多的电话淹没时才休息。

sentences.en: We are just very considerate of each other.
sentences.zh: 我们只是非常体谅彼此。

sentences.en: And everybody in the team tends to be real good, hard workers and considerate of each other that way.
sentences.zh: 团队里的每个人往往都是非常优秀、努力工作且体谅彼此的人。

sentences.en: To Cynthia, it was obvious her team was good at what it did.
sentences.zh: 对辛西娅来说，她的团队擅长自己的工作是显而易见的。

sentences.en: But she says that didn't stop the company's human resources department from conducting personality tests to draw out deeper truths about the employees.
sentences.zh: 但她说，这并没有阻止公司的人力资源部门进行性格测试，以挖掘员工内心更深层的真相。

sentences.en: Our company, which is a smaller company, was purchased by another company.
sentences.zh: 我们公司是一家较小的公司，被另一家公司收购了。

sentences.en: And the HR department for the larger company sent an email out to all of us in the new company asking us just to do a personality teSt.
sentences.zh: 那家大公司的HR部门给我们新公司的所有人发了一封邮件，要求我们做一个性格测试。

sentences.en: And they said the reason they wanted us to do it was just to help our managers better manage us.
sentences.zh: 他们说要求我们做这个测试，只是为了帮助我们的经理更好地管理我们。

sentences.en: Cynthia says she and her colleagues were in a bind.
sentences.zh: 辛西娅说她和同事们当时陷入了困境。

sentences.en: We were concerned that if we refused to do it, that maybe, I don't know, maybe they would fire us or something like that.
sentences.zh: 我们担心如果不做这个测试，我不知道，也许他们会解雇我们之类的。

sentences.en: And they were sending out a number of reminders to do the teSt.
sentences.zh: 而且他们还不断地发提醒邮件，催促我们完成测试。

sentences.en: So she took it.
sentences.zh: 所以她还是做了。

sentences.en: The test was called the culture index.
sentences.zh: 这个测试叫“文化指数”。

sentences.en: It was very short.
sentences.zh: 它非常简短。

sentences.en: On the first page, Cynthia was asked to pick adjectives that described her.
sentences.zh: 第一页，辛西娅被要求挑选形容自己的形容词。

sentences.en: On the second page, she had to pick adjectives that described her on the job.
sentences.zh: 第二页，她必须挑选形容自己在工作中状态的形容词。

sentences.en: That was it.
sentences.zh: 就这样。

sentences.en: What kind of words were they on these two, when you saw the pages, describe the test to me?
sentences.zh: 当你看到这两页纸时，上面的词是什么样的？给我描述一下这个测试。

sentences.en: Yeah, so the words were things like calm, patient, knowledgeable, logical, friendly, outgoing, attractive.
sentences.zh: 嗯，词汇大概是冷静、耐心、知识渊博、逻辑性强、友好、外向、有吸引力之类的。

sentences.en: Cynthia remembers picking words that she felt reflected who she was.
sentences.zh: 辛西娅记得她挑选的都是她认为能反映自己真实性格的词。

sentences.en: Calm, patient, resourceful, logical, friendly.
sentences.zh: 冷静、耐心、足智多谋、逻辑性强、友好。

sentences.en: A couple days later, she says, HR emailed her the results.
sentences.zh: 她说，几天后，HR通过邮件把结果发给了她。

sentences.en: They rated people in seven categories.
sentences.zh: 他们从七个维度对人进行评估。

sentences.en: Autonomy, social ability, pace, conformity, logic, ingenuity, and energy units.
sentences.zh: 自主性、社交能力、节奏、从众性、逻辑、创造力和能量单位。

sentences.en: Most of the scales ran from one to ten, with ten being the beSt.
sentences.zh: 大多数量表的评分范围是一到十分，十分是最好的。

sentences.en: Cynthia learned she'd scored a one for all the categories, except energy.
sentences.zh: 辛西娅发现除了能量那一项，她在所有类别中都只得了1分。

sentences.en: That category had a maximum score of 100.
sentences.zh: 那一项的最高分是100分。

sentences.en: She got 12.
sentences.zh: 她得了12分。

sentences.en: Then there's a write-up.
sentences.zh: 然后还有一份书面报告。

sentences.en: So they have a graph when you get your results.
sentences.zh: 当你拿到结果时，他们会提供一张图表。

sentences.en: So there's two very scientific-looking graphs, and then they have a write-up.
sentences.zh: 所以会有两张看起来非常科学的图表，然后还有一份书面报告。

sentences.en: And the write-up for me said, it says,
sentences.zh: 关于我的那份报告上写着，它是这样说的：

sentences.en: this individual has very little energy and may require more breaks during the workday than most individuals.
sentences.zh: “此人能量极低，在工作日期间可能比大多数人需要更多的休息时间。”

sentences.en: And most people, a lot of my coworkers, got kind of similar comments.
sentences.zh: 而且大多数人，我的很多同事，都收到了类似的评价。

sentences.en: Some not quite as severe.
sentences.zh: 有些没那么严重。

sentences.en: Some said, this person runs out of energy by the afternoon and will need breaks in the afternoon.
sentences.zh: 有的写着：“此人到下午就会耗尽能量，下午需要休息。”

sentences.en: So what was your interpretation when the energy scale runs from 2 to 100 and you were rated at 12?
sentences.zh: 那么，当能量量表的范围是2到100，而你被评为12分时，你是怎么解读的？

sentences.en: What was your reaction to that?
sentences.zh: 你对此有什么反应？

sentences.en: Oh, I thought it was ridiculous.
sentences.zh: 哦，我觉得这太荒谬了。

sentences.en: Like, I had no idea how they calculated that.
sentences.zh: 我根本不知道他们是怎么计算出来的。

sentences.en: And it really is, of all the things that they said about me, that is the most blatantly wrong.
sentences.zh: 而且说实话，在他们评价我的所有内容中，这一点是最明目张胆的错误。

sentences.en: And anybody who knows me would actually know that's true.
sentences.zh: 任何了解我的人其实都知道这是事实。

sentences.en: I mean, honestly, I think if you make it through veterinary school, you have to have a certain amount of energy.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，老实说，我认为如果你能读完兽医学校，你就必须具备一定的能量。

sentences.en: I just, I mean, and I just, you know, I just always work very hard, and I always have.
sentences.zh: 我只是，我的意思是，你知道，我一直工作非常努力，而且一直都是这样。

sentences.en: It's really been kind of the defining characteristic of my life, I would say.
sentences.zh: 我可以说，这确实是我人生中一种决定性的特质。

sentences.en: Cynthia says the experience felt insulting.
sentences.zh: 辛西娅说这种经历让她感到受辱。

sentences.en: So I looked into the teSt.
sentences.zh: 所以我调查了一下这个测试。

sentences.en: Honestly, it was my reaction.
sentences.zh: 老实说，这就是我的反应。

sentences.en: I, you know, I had gone into it assuming that it was an accepted test by the psychological community.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我一开始假设这是一个被心理学界认可的测试。

sentences.en: And then when I looked into it, I saw that they have no peer-reviewed published data at all.
sentences.zh: 但当我深入调查后，我发现他们根本没有任何经过同行评审的发表数据。

sentences.en: And actually, they don't call themselves a teSt.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他们甚至不称自己为“测试”。

sentences.en: They insist on calling themselves a personality survey.
sentences.zh: 他们坚持称自己为“性格调查”。

sentences.en: So I just couldn't believe that any company would put any validity to this.
sentences.zh: 所以我简直无法相信竟然有公司会把这东西当回事。

sentences.en: Gary Wallstrom is the founder of the Culture Index, the test that Cynthia took.
sentences.zh: 加里·沃尔斯特罗姆是“文化指数”的创始人，也就是辛西娅参加的那个测试。

sentences.en: He declined to do a recorded interview, but spoke to us by phone.
sentences.zh: 他拒绝接受录音采访，但通过电话与我们进行了交谈。

sentences.en: He says that Cynthia, quote, doesn't know what she's talking about.
sentences.zh: 他说辛西娅“根本不知道自己在说什么”。

sentences.en: Gary is not a psychologist, but says the survey was developed in consultation with a psychology professor.
sentences.zh: 加里不是心理学家，但他表示该调查是在一位心理学教授的咨询下开发的。

sentences.en: He agreed that the Culture Index has not been through a scientific peer review process,
sentences.zh: 他承认“文化指数”没有经过科学的同行评审过程，

sentences.en: but he has confidence that it helps companies manage and motivate people based on their personality.
sentences.zh: 但他坚信它能帮助公司根据员工的性格来管理和激励他们。

sentences.en: He says it helps with hiring decisions.
sentences.zh: 他说这有助于招聘决策。

sentences.en: It allows managers to make sure the personality of the individual fits the personality of the position.
sentences.zh: 它允许经理确保个人的性格与职位的要求相匹配。

sentences.en: The Culture Index is one of many personality assessments that companies can choose from.
sentences.zh: “文化指数”是公司可以选择的众多性格评估工具之一。

sentences.en: As advertising and infomercials make abundantly clear,
sentences.zh: 正如广告和电视购物节目所明确展示的那样，

sentences.en: for most of the positions we create,
sentences.zh: 对于我们创造的大多数职位，

sentences.en: they're being used all the time in important decisions.
sentences.zh: 这些测试一直被用于重要的决策中。

sentences.en: In fact, job applicants are so aware of how seriously companies take these tests
sentences.zh: 事实上，求职者非常清楚公司对这些测试的重视程度，

sentences.en: that services have popped up to tell people how to hack the tests.
sentences.zh: 以至于出现了一些专门教人如何“破解”这些测试的服务。

sentences.en: We searched YouTube and found homegrown videos like this one.
sentences.zh: 我们在YouTube上搜索并找到了像这样的自制视频。

sentences.en: Let us go through a couple of example true or false questions.
sentences.zh: 让我们来看几个判断题的例子。

sentences.en: Despite the poor audio quality, this video,
sentences.zh: 尽管音频质量很差，但这个视频，

sentences.en: How to Pass a Pre-Employment Personality Test,
sentences.zh: 《如何通过入职前的性格测试》，

sentences.en: has racked up nearly 300,000 views.
sentences.zh: 已经积累了近30万次观看。

sentences.en: I always love to be in large, noisy crowds.
sentences.zh: “我总是喜欢待在人多嘈杂的地方。”

sentences.en: You may not always like to be in large, noisy crowds,
sentences.zh: 你可能并不总是喜欢待在人多嘈杂的地方，

sentences.en: so you might answer false.
sentences.zh: 所以你可能会回答“错误”。

sentences.en: What they are really asking is whether or not you like people
sentences.zh: 但他们真正想问的是你是否喜欢与人打交道，

sentences.en: and can deal with it at work when it is busy.
sentences.zh: 以及在工作繁忙时能否应付得来。

sentences.en: That makes the answer true.
sentences.zh: 这使得答案变成了“正确”。

sentences.en: Most companies use the Myers-Briggs,
sentences.zh: 大多数公司使用迈尔斯-布里格斯类型指标（MBTI），

sentences.en: which is widely considered to be an industry standard.
sentences.zh: 它被广泛认为是行业标准。

sentences.en: This test has an interesting history.
sentences.zh: 这个测试有一段有趣的历史。

sentences.en: It originated in the ideas of a contemporary of Sigmund Freud, Carl Jung.
sentences.zh: 它起源于西格蒙德·弗洛伊德的同时代人卡尔·荣格的思想。

sentences.en: He identified three dimensions of personality.
sentences.zh: 他确定了性格的三个维度。

sentences.en: This is Alan Hammer,
sentences.zh: 这位是艾伦·哈默，

sentences.en: a psychologist and former chair of the Myers-Briggs Foundation.
sentences.zh: 一位心理学家，也是迈尔斯-布里格斯基金会的前任主席。

sentences.en: One was where you tend to focus your attention.
sentences.zh: 第一个维度是你倾向于将注意力集中在哪里。

sentences.en: And he said that there are two opposite ways you can focus your attention.
sentences.zh: 他说有两种相反的方式可以集中你的注意力。

sentences.en: One is on the external world.
sentences.zh: 一种是关注外部世界。

sentences.en: He called that extroversion.
sentences.zh: 他称之为“外向”。

sentences.en: And one is on the internal world.
sentences.zh: 另一种是关注内心世界。

sentences.en: He called that introversion.
sentences.zh: 他称之为“内向”。

sentences.en: Category two is about how people perceive the world.
sentences.zh: 第二个类别是关于人们如何感知世界。

sentences.en: Some people focus on details, on facts.
sentences.zh: 有些人关注细节，关注事实。

sentences.en: Others are more intuitive, imaginative.
sentences.zh: 另一些人则更直觉、更具想象力。

sentences.en: The third category is whether people are driven by thinking or by emotion.
sentences.zh: 第三个类别是人们是由思考驱动还是由情感驱动。

sentences.en: Thinking is a way of objectively looking at a situation,
sentences.zh: 思考是一种客观审视情况的方式，

sentences.en: making a detached, objective, logical, analytical decision or judgment about something.
sentences.zh: 对某事做出超然、客观、逻辑、分析性的决定或判断。

sentences.en: Whereas the opposite of that is what he called feeling,
sentences.zh: 而与之相反的是他所说的“情感”，

sentences.en: the subjective, interpersonal way of making a decision.
sentences.zh: 即一种主观的、人际交往式的决策方式。

sentences.en: In the 1940s, an American woman named Isabel Myers became interested in Jung's ideas.
sentences.zh: 20世纪40年代，一位名叫伊莎贝尔·迈尔斯的美国女性对荣格的思想产生了兴趣。

sentences.en: Her mother actually was interested in Jung firSt.
sentences.zh: 实际上，她的母亲先对荣格产生了兴趣。

sentences.en: And then Isabel, who was a housewife at the time and a writer,
sentences.zh: 然后伊莎贝尔，当时是一位家庭主妇兼作家，

sentences.en: she got interested in type and then started looking at applications,
sentences.zh: 她对性格类型产生了兴趣，并开始研究其应用，

sentences.en: particularly around careers.
sentences.zh: 特别是在职业领域。

sentences.en: Isabel Myers, along with her mother, Catherine Cook Briggs,
sentences.zh: 伊莎贝尔·迈尔斯和她的母亲凯瑟琳·库克·布里格斯一起，

sentences.en: turned Jung's theories into a teSt.
sentences.zh: 将荣格的理论变成了一个测试。

sentences.en: She also added her own ideas into the mix.
sentences.zh: 她还加入了自己的想法。

sentences.en: Isabel Myers added a fourth dimension,
sentences.zh: 伊莎贝尔·迈尔斯增加了第四个维度，

sentences.en: which she described as which of those two processes you tend to use in the outer world.
sentences.zh: 她将其描述为你在外部世界倾向于使用这两个过程中的哪一个。

sentences.en: So she said you either tend to use a judging function in the outer world
sentences.zh: 所以她说，你要么倾向于在外部世界使用判断功能，

sentences.en: or a perceiving function in the outer world.
sentences.zh: 要么在外部世界使用感知功能。

sentences.en: And that's represented by the letters J and P.
sentences.zh: 这由字母J和P来表示。

sentences.en: So those are the four dimensions.
sentences.zh: 这就是四个维度。

sentences.en: And when you combine the four dimensions and the two opposites on each dimension,
sentences.zh: 当你结合这四个维度以及每个维度上的两个对立面时，

sentences.en: you get 16 different types.
sentences.zh: 你会得到16种不同的类型。

sentences.en: Even though Isabel Myers and her mother were self-taught,
sentences.zh: 尽管伊莎贝尔·迈尔斯和她的母亲是自学成才的，

sentences.en: many of the researchers who have worked on the test since then are psychologists.
sentences.zh: 但自那以后参与该测试工作的许多研究人员都是心理学家。

sentences.en: Nonetheless, despite the widespread popularity of the Myers-Briggs test,
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，尽管迈尔斯-布里格斯测试非常受欢迎，

sentences.en: it's generally not held in high regard by top psychologists who study personality.
sentences.zh: 但研究性格的顶尖心理学家通常并不看重它。

sentences.en: Adam Grant is a professor of psychology and management at the University of Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 亚当·格兰特是宾夕法尼亚大学的心理学和管理学教授。

sentences.en: When he first took the Myers-Briggs, he learned that he was an INTJ.
sentences.zh: 当他第一次参加迈尔斯-布里格斯测试时，他得知自己是INTJ。

sentences.en: In other words, an introvert, an intuiter, a thinker, and a judger.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，内向、直觉、思考、判断型。

sentences.en: Fine, he said.
sentences.zh: “好吧，”他说。

sentences.en: But then, a few months later, he took the test again.
sentences.zh: 但几个月后，他又参加了一次测试。

sentences.en: I got opposite scores on every dimension.
sentences.zh: 我在每个维度上都得到了相反的分数。

sentences.en: I scored, uh, now I was ESFP.
sentences.zh: 我得分，呃，这次变成了ESFP。

sentences.en: Adam says fans of the Myers-Briggs tend to shrug off such discrepancies.
sentences.zh: 亚当说，迈尔斯-布里格斯的粉丝往往会对这种差异不以为然。

sentences.en: Well, they say either, you know, you're gaming the test and you want a different answer.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们要么说，你知道，你在操纵测试，你想要一个不同的答案。

sentences.en: I could not have wanted something more opposite.
sentences.zh: 我不可能想要一个更相反的结果。

sentences.en: I wanted consistency.
sentences.zh: 我想要的是一致性。

sentences.en: See, I wanted to know who I was.
sentences.zh: 你看，我想知道我是谁。

sentences.en: I was trying really hard to answer them the same way.
sentences.zh: 我真的很努力地以同样的方式回答它们。

sentences.en: I began to question whether this test had any validity and reliability whatsoever.
sentences.zh: 我开始怀疑这个测试是否具有任何有效性和可靠性。

sentences.en: Validity and reliability.
sentences.zh: 有效性和可靠性。

sentences.en: These are two of the most important scientific factors to consider
sentences.zh: 这是在判断任何心理测试的价值时，

sentences.en: when judging the value of any psychological teSt.
sentences.zh: 需要考虑的两个最重要的科学因素。

sentences.en: Validity indicates the extent to which the test measures what it is supposed to measure.
sentences.zh: 有效性是指测试测量其预期测量目标的程度。

sentences.en: Reliability refers to whether the test produces consistent results
sentences.zh: 可靠性是指当进行重复测量时，测试是否产生一致的结果。

sentences.en: when repeated measurements are made.
sentences.zh: 亚当·格兰特说，迈尔斯-布里格斯在这两个方面都表现不佳。

sentences.en: Adam Grant says the Myers-Briggs comes up short in both areas.
sentences.zh: 它在可靠性或有效性方面做得并不好。

sentences.en: It doesn't do very well in reliability or validity.
sentences.zh: 它远未达到大多数传统的可靠性标准。

sentences.en: It falls well short of most conventional reliability standards.
sentences.zh: 而且迈尔斯-布里格斯的支持者自己也会告诉你，它无法预测任何事情。

sentences.en: And the Myers-Briggs proponents themselves will tell you that it doesn't predict anything.
sentences.zh: 关于性格测试，让我担心的不是那些可能不准确但大多只是为了好玩的内容，

sentences.en: The thing that concerns me about personality tests is less the stuff that might be inaccurate but is mostly just fun,
sentences.zh: 而是那些越来越多地被用来衡量谁应该在职场中做什么，

sentences.en: and more the stuff that is increasingly being used to gauge who should be doing what in the workplace,
sentences.zh: 谁最适合哪种职业，以及挑选那些你想在组织中提拔的人的内容。

sentences.en: who is best suited for which career, to select the people who you want to rise within an organization.
sentences.zh: 这是扼杀各种多样性的绝佳方式。

sentences.en: It's a great way to weed out all kinds of diversity.
sentences.zh: 不久前，加拿大有一家公司发生了一次重大收购，

sentences.en: There was a company in Canada not long ago where there was a major acquisition made,
sentences.zh: 首席执行官让所有被收购的人都做了迈尔斯-布里格斯测试，然后解雇了所有与他类型不符的人。

sentences.en: and the CEO gave every single person who was acquired the Myers-Briggs and then fired everyone who didn't match his type.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Good grief.
sentences.zh: 这太可怕了。

sentences.en: That's terrifying.
sentences.zh: 许多性格研究人员更看重一种被称为“大五人格”的测试。

sentences.en: Many personality researchers put greater stock in a test known as the Big Five.
sentences.zh: 它衡量的是你对他人的意见有多在意，以及你对自己的判断有多坚持等特质。

sentences.en: It measures things like how much you care about the opinions of others versus your own judgment.
sentences.zh: 它还衡量内向和外向等品质。

sentences.en: It also measures qualities such as introversion and extroversion.
sentences.zh: 乍一看，这个测试与迈尔斯-布里格斯及其他性格测试之间有相似之处。

sentences.en: At first glance, there are similarities between this test and the Myers-Briggs and other personality tests.
sentences.zh: 但亚当说，“大五人格”有大量经过同行评审的数据作为支撑。

sentences.en: But Adam says the Big Five has large amounts of peer-reviewed data to back it up.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么它在科学界更受认可。

sentences.en: That data, he argues, makes for better predictions.
sentences.zh: 他认为，这些数据能带来更好的预测结果。

sentences.en: And what you're saying is that scores on this Big Five personality test do what compared to the Myers-Briggs?
sentences.zh: 那么你的意思是，与迈尔斯-布里格斯类型指标（MBTI）相比，大五人格测试的得分能起到什么作用？

sentences.en: We can predict your job performance, your effectiveness in a team with different collaborators,
sentences.zh: 我们可以预测你的工作表现，以及你在与不同同事合作时的团队效率，

sentences.en: your likelihood of sticking around in a job versus leaving.
sentences.zh: 还有你留任或离职的可能性。

sentences.en: As well as your probability of your marriage surviving, depending on the personality fit between you and your spouse.
sentences.zh: 以及根据你与配偶之间的人格契合度，预测你们婚姻存续的概率。

sentences.en: But Alan Hammer, the psychologist who's a proponent of the Myers-Briggs test, disagrees with Adam.
sentences.zh: 但迈尔斯-布里格斯测试的支持者、心理学家艾伦·哈默（Alan Hammer）并不同意亚当的观点。

sentences.en: He believes the Myers-Briggs is as reliable as other personality tests.
sentences.zh: 他认为迈尔斯-布里格斯测试和其他人格测试一样可靠。

sentences.en: And he says that Adam's wrong when it comes to the evidence that the Myers-Briggs cannot predict real-world outcomes.
sentences.zh: 他还表示，亚当关于迈尔斯-布里格斯测试无法预测现实世界结果的证据是错误的。

sentences.en: When people matched roommates on their psychological type, they got a 65% decrease in requests for roommate changes.
sentences.zh: 当人们根据心理类型来匹配室友时，更换室友的请求减少了65%。

sentences.en: Where Alan agrees with Adam is that the Myers-Briggs is often used in ways it should not be used.
sentences.zh: 艾伦与亚当达成共识的一点是，迈尔斯-布里格斯测试经常被不当使用。

sentences.en: The people who go through the certification programs learn how not to do this.
sentences.zh: 参加认证课程的人会学习如何避免这种不当使用。

sentences.en: But yes, this instrument as well as any instrument is misused.
sentences.zh: 但确实，这种工具和其他任何工具一样，都会被滥用。

sentences.en: That's true.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: The Myers-Briggs Foundation has an ethics statement for the MBTI.
sentences.zh: 迈尔斯-布里格斯基金会为MBTI制定了道德准则。

sentences.en: That statement says,
sentences.zh: 该准则指出，

sentences.en: Although there are many useful applications of the MBTI assessment in the workplace,
sentences.zh: 尽管MBTI评估在职场中有许多有益的应用，

sentences.en: there are ethical concerns in using it for hiring purposes.
sentences.zh: 但在招聘中使用它存在道德方面的顾虑。

sentences.en: Again, Alan Hammer.
sentences.zh: 再次引用艾伦·哈默的话。

sentences.en: I don't think the MBTI should ever be used to either select people into an occupation or to promote them.
sentences.zh: 我认为MBTI绝不应该用于筛选求职者或进行晋升评估。

sentences.en: And I've worked in large corporations for, with corporate, large corporations for the past, I guess, 25 years.
sentences.zh: 我在大型企业工作了，我想大概有25年了，一直都在企业界工作。

sentences.en: And we've never, ever used it that way.
sentences.zh: 我们从来、从来没有那样使用过它。

sentences.en: I hear what Alan is saying, but I would argue that these tests are popular precisely because they purport to give us a quick snapshot of who someone is and what they're good at.
sentences.zh: 我听到了艾伦的观点，但我认为这些测试之所以受欢迎，恰恰是因为它们声称能让我们快速了解一个人的特质及其擅长之处。

sentences.en: If you're a manager and you learn one of your employees is an introvert, according to the test,
sentences.zh: 如果你是一名经理，根据测试结果得知你的某位员工是内向者，

sentences.en: it's absurd to think this won't shape the way you decide whether that employee should have a public-facing role.
sentences.zh: 认为这不会影响你决定该员工是否适合担任对公职位的想法是荒谬的。

sentences.en: By a show of hands and wands, how many people are familiar with Myers-Briggs type indicators?
sentences.zh: 请举手示意，有多少人熟悉迈尔斯-布里格斯类型指标？

sentences.en: Back at the Harry Potter conference, I stopped by a panel discussion.
sentences.zh: 在哈利·波特大会上，我参加了一个小组讨论。

sentences.en: It was called Hogwarts Houses as Personality Types.
sentences.zh: 主题是“霍格沃茨学院作为人格类型”。

sentences.en: It was packed, standing room only.
sentences.zh: 现场座无虚席，连站的地方都没有。

sentences.en: People were even sitting in the aisles.
sentences.zh: 人们甚至坐在过道里。

sentences.en: The panel leader, Jessica Comstock, was listing off the personality traits that made people suited for each of the different houses.
sentences.zh: 小组负责人杰西卡·康斯托克（Jessica Comstock）列举了使人们适合不同学院的人格特质。

sentences.en: The people who are extroverts are people who like to be the center of attention,
sentences.zh: 外向的人是那些喜欢成为关注中心的人，

sentences.en: people who like to have things go, go, go all the time,
sentences.zh: 喜欢事情一直不停地推进的人，

sentences.en: and people who recharge by being around others.
sentences.zh: 以及通过与他人相处来充电的人。

sentences.en: Gryffindors.
sentences.zh: 格兰芬多。

sentences.en: Jessica is a self-described Harry Potter nerd.
sentences.zh: 杰西卡自称是哈利·波特迷。

sentences.en: She spends much of her free time researching, analyzing, and lecturing on various themes in the books.
sentences.zh: 她大部分空闲时间都在研究、分析和讲解书中的各种主题。

sentences.en: She saw a graphic on the Internet one day that correlated Harry Potter characters to the Myers-Briggs.
sentences.zh: 有一天，她在网上看到一张图表，将哈利·波特角色与迈尔斯-布里格斯类型联系起来。

sentences.en: It was cute, but she felt misguided.
sentences.zh: 这很有趣，但她觉得这种联系有些误导。

sentences.en: She thought the houses, rather than individual characters, made for a better correlation.
sentences.zh: 她认为用学院而非单个角色来对应会更准确。

sentences.en: How many people know their personality type?
sentences.zh: 有多少人知道自己的人格类型？

sentences.en: So Jessica designed a detailed chart to show how closely Hogwarts Houses align with Myers-Briggs categories.
sentences.zh: 于是杰西卡设计了一张详细的图表，展示霍格沃茨学院与迈尔斯-布里格斯分类的契合程度。

sentences.en: I'm going to do a little experiment with the first few people.
sentences.zh: 我要和前几位观众做一个小实验。

sentences.en: So, what is your MBTI?
sentences.zh: 那么，你的MBTI是什么？

sentences.en: ISTP.
sentences.zh: ISTP。

sentences.en: Jessica looks at her chart.
sentences.zh: 杰西卡查看她的图表。

sentences.en: ISTP matches to Slytherin.
sentences.zh: ISTP对应斯莱特林。

sentences.en: What is your house?
sentences.zh: 你是哪个学院的？

sentences.en: Yes, it is.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: Somebody from another section.
sentences.zh: 请另一区的观众。

sentences.en: Yellow.
sentences.zh: 黄色。

sentences.en: Said ESFJ or Hufflepuff.
sentences.zh: 说是ESFJ或赫奇帕奇。

sentences.en: Right again.
sentences.zh: 又对了。

sentences.en: The audience soaks it in.
sentences.zh: 观众们沉浸其中。

sentences.en: And if anybody thinks I'm cheating, you're welcome to come and look at my notes.
sentences.zh: 如果有人认为我在作弊，欢迎过来看看我的笔记。

sentences.en: To the folks at Potterverse, the fact that there's a connection between being an ESFJ and a Hufflepuff
sentences.zh: 对于“波特宇宙”的粉丝来说，ESFJ和赫奇帕奇之间存在联系这一事实，

sentences.en: is proof that the Hogwarts Houses are real signs.
sentences.zh: 证明了霍格沃茨学院是真实的人格标志。

sentences.en: But as I sit and listen,
sentences.zh: 但当我坐着倾听时，

sentences.en: What is your house?
sentences.zh: 你是哪个学院的？

sentences.en: I find Jessica's chart dumbfounding.
sentences.zh: 我发现杰西卡的图表令人震惊。

sentences.en: Yes, it is.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: If Harry Potter houses can replicate personality tests that companies are using to determine which employees get jobs or get fired,
sentences.zh: 如果哈利·波特的学院可以复制公司用来决定员工录用或解雇的人格测试，

sentences.en: As I said earlier,
sentences.zh: 正如我之前所说，

sentences.en: As I said earlier, good grief.
sentences.zh: 正如我之前所说，天哪。

sentences.en: By this point, you know where my head is at.
sentences.zh: 到了这一步，你知道我的想法了。

sentences.en: I was disturbed by the multi-billion dollar industry that is being created around personality tests.
sentences.zh: 我对围绕人格测试建立起来的数十亿美元产业感到不安。

sentences.en: But then, as often happens, I heard a mind-bending story that made me think about these tests in a different way.
sentences.zh: 但随后，正如经常发生的那样，我听到了一个令人震撼的故事，让我以不同的方式思考这些测试。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantham.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·维丹塔姆（Shankar Vedantham）。

sentences.en: This is Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 这是《隐藏的大脑》（Hidden Brain）。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: This is Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 这是《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantham.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·维丹塔姆。

sentences.en: As I talked to Adam Grant about personality tests, I became convinced it was a terrible idea to use such tests to hire and fire people.
sentences.zh: 当我和亚当·格兰特谈论人格测试时，我确信利用这些测试来招聘和解雇员工是个糟糕的主意。

sentences.en: But then, as we were reporting the story, I came across some research that made me think about personality classifications in a different way.
sentences.zh: 但后来，在报道这个故事时，我偶然发现了一些研究，让我对人格分类有了不同的看法。

sentences.en: Now, it's absolutely true that many personality tests are unscientific and unreliable.
sentences.zh: 现在，许多人格测试确实是不科学且不可靠的。

sentences.en: But does that mean they're useless?
sentences.zh: 但这是否意味着它们毫无用处？

sentences.en: At Louisiana State University, the economist Najee Mojan was looking at how beliefs shape economic choices.
sentences.zh: 在路易斯安那州立大学，经济学家纳吉·莫詹（Najee Mojan）正在研究信仰如何塑造经济选择。

sentences.en: His subject wasn't the Harry Potter sorting hat, but a more ancient way to classify personality, the Chinese zodiac.
sentences.zh: 他的研究对象不是哈利·波特的分院帽，而是一种更古老的人格分类方式：中国生肖。

sentences.en: Our story begins in Anhui province in China in 1987.
sentences.zh: 我们的故事始于1987年的中国安徽省。

sentences.en: A young Chinese couple had decided to start a family.
sentences.zh: 一对年轻的中国夫妇决定组建家庭。

sentences.en: Shaoqi and his wife, Yangsheng, were happily married, and the timing was right.
sentences.zh: 邵奇和他的妻子杨胜婚姻幸福，时机也恰到好处。

sentences.en: It was soon going to be 1988.
sentences.zh: 很快就要到1988年了。

sentences.en: As hundreds of millions of Chinese knew, this was the most significant year.
sentences.zh: 正如数亿中国人所知，这是最重要的一年。

sentences.en: After 11 years of rats and roosters and snakes and sheep, it was finally going to be the year of the dragon.
sentences.zh: 在经历了11年的鼠、鸡、蛇、羊之后，终于要迎来龙年了。

sentences.en: According to Chinese tradition, there's no better year for a child to be born than the year of the dragon.
sentences.zh: 根据中国传统，没有比龙年更适合生孩子的年份了。

sentences.en: Dragon kids are destined for greatness.
sentences.zh: 龙宝宝注定会成就非凡。

sentences.en: Shaoqi was a doctor at one of the province's largest hospitals.
sentences.zh: 邵奇是该省一家大型医院的医生。

sentences.en: He knew it was going to be a crazy year.
sentences.zh: 他知道这将是疯狂的一年。

sentences.en: Pregnant women were already pre-booking rooms at the hospital.
sentences.zh: 孕妇们已经在提前预订医院的床位了。

sentences.en: Births were going to skyrocket.
sentences.zh: 出生率将飙升。

sentences.en: It was the same across the country.
sentences.zh: 全国各地都是如此。

sentences.en: It seemed that pregnant women were everywhere, dreaming of the greatness of their coming dragon babies.
sentences.zh: 似乎到处都是孕妇，她们梦想着即将出生的龙宝宝能成就伟业。

sentences.en: Shaoqi and Yangsheng lived in Hefei, a city with a famous history for producing brilliant minds and well-educated people.
sentences.zh: 邵奇和杨胜住在合肥，这是一座以培养聪明才智和高素质人才而闻名的城市。

sentences.en: So when their son Han Yu arrived, as planned, in that most auspicious year, they already had big plans for him.
sentences.zh: 因此，当他们的儿子韩宇如期在那个最吉祥的年份出生时，他们已经为他制定了宏伟的计划。

sentences.en: Shaoqi wanted Han Yu to be even better educated than himself, ideally at a top-ranked university in the United States.
sentences.zh: 邵奇希望韩宇受到的教育比自己更好，最好能进入美国顶尖大学。

sentences.en: And so, mother and father quickly instilled in the very young child the conviction that great things were expected of him.
sentences.zh: 于是，父母很快就在年幼的孩子心中灌输了对他寄予厚望的信念。

sentences.en: This idea is kind of indoctrinated in my mind.
sentences.zh: 这个想法在我的脑海里根深蒂固。

sentences.en: So when people ask me what I want to do, when I think about it, I really think that I want to be a PhD in the future.
sentences.zh: 所以当人们问我想做什么时，当我思考这个问题时，我真的认为我未来想成为一名博士。

sentences.en: I want to be a doctor.
sentences.zh: 我想成为一名医生。

sentences.en: That was the beginning of a long march.
sentences.zh: 那是漫长征程的开始。

sentences.en: Han recalls that when he was in middle school, his father came home one day at lunchtime, bearing an armful of textbooks.
sentences.zh: 韩回忆说，他上初中时，有一天父亲午饭时间回到家，怀里抱着一堆教科书。

sentences.en: And he just came back at noon one day and put some books in my bookcase.
sentences.zh: 有一天中午他回来，把一些书放进了我的书架。

sentences.en: And I asked him, hey dad, what did you buy?
sentences.zh: 我问他，嘿爸爸，你买了什么？

sentences.en: He told me that those are some textbooks for master degree students to practice their English.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，那是给硕士生练习英语的教科书。

sentences.en: You know, at that time I was, I was, I was 13.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那时候我，我，我13岁。

sentences.en: Master's degree books for a 13-year-old.
sentences.zh: 给13岁孩子看的硕士教材。

sentences.en: Shaoqi explained to Han that mastering English would be essential if he was to do well at that fancy university in America.
sentences.zh: 邵奇向韩解释说，如果他想在美国那所高级大学取得好成绩，精通英语至关重要。

sentences.en: He and Youngsheng spared their child from doing any household chores.
sentences.zh: 他和杨胜让孩子免于做任何家务。

sentences.en: All Han had to do was to achieve his parents' dreaMs.
sentences.zh: 韩唯一要做的就是实现父母的梦想。

sentences.en: When I was at home, my father always said,
sentences.zh: 我在家的时候，我父亲总是说，

sentences.en: Hey son, I don't want you to do any housework at home.
sentences.zh: 嘿儿子，我不想让你在家里做任何家务。

sentences.en: You just need to focus.
sentences.zh: 你只需要专注。

sentences.en: Perhaps that's not right, but he said that we just need you to focus on study.
sentences.zh: 也许这不对，但他确实说我们只需要你专注于学习。

sentences.en: Han finished college and his master's degree in China.
sentences.zh: 韩在中国完成了大学和硕士学业。

sentences.en: And then, as planned, he went off to the United States for even more education.
sentences.zh: 然后，按照计划，他前往美国接受进一步的教育。

sentences.en: Han enrolled in an economics PhD program at Louisiana State University,
sentences.zh: 韩进入了路易斯安那州立大学的经济学博士项目，

sentences.en: where he met a mentor whose expectations of him were every bit as high as those of his own parents.
sentences.zh: 在那里他遇到了一位导师，导师对他的期望和他的父母一样高。

sentences.en: My name is Najee Mojan.
sentences.zh: 我叫纳吉·莫詹。

sentences.en: I am a professor of economics at Louisiana State University
sentences.zh: 我是路易斯安那州立大学的经济学教授，

sentences.en: and a research associate of the National Bureau of Economic Research.
sentences.zh: 也是美国国家经济研究局的研究助理。

sentences.en: Najee is Han's PhD advisor.
sentences.zh: 纳吉是韩的博士导师。

sentences.en: When Han told Najee about life in China,
sentences.zh: 当韩向纳吉讲述在中国的生活时，

sentences.en: they talked about the Chinese zodiac and the power of the year of the dragon.
sentences.zh: 他们谈到了中国生肖和龙年的力量。

sentences.en: They were sure that belief in the zodiac was just superstition.
sentences.zh: 他们确信对生肖的信仰只是迷信。

sentences.en: In fact, they were certain that anyone who was born in the year of the dragon
sentences.zh: 事实上，他们确信任何出生在龙年的人，

sentences.en: would actually be at a great disadvantage.
sentences.zh: 实际上会处于巨大的劣势。

sentences.en: If there is half a million extra kids born in the year of the dragon,
sentences.zh: 如果龙年多出生了五十万个孩子，

sentences.en: those kids will have more peers in the classrooMs.
sentences.zh: 这些孩子在课堂上会有更多的同龄人。

sentences.en: There's going to be, there would be fewer resources per child in the schools.
sentences.zh: 学校里每个孩子能分配到的资源会变少。

sentences.en: The classrooms are a little bit more crowded, etc.
sentences.zh: 教室会稍微拥挤一些，等等。

sentences.en: We would expect worse educational outcomes rather than better.
sentences.zh: 我们预计教育成果会变差，而不是变好。

sentences.en: They decided to prove their hypothesis that dragon kids would fare worse than other kids at school.
sentences.zh: 他们决定验证他们的假设，即龙宝宝在学校的表现会比其他孩子差。

sentences.en: As it turned out, the Chinese government has a treasure trove of data.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，中国政府拥有海量的数据。

sentences.en: The academic performance of middle schoolers, demographic surveys,
sentences.zh: 初中生的学业成绩、人口统计调查，

sentences.en: interviews with parents about their own education and household income.
sentences.zh: 关于父母自身教育程度和家庭收入的访谈。

sentences.en: And so the two economists collected all the data,
sentences.zh: 于是这两位经济学家收集了所有数据，

sentences.en: control for different variables, and crunched the numbers.
sentences.zh: 控制了不同的变量，并进行了计算。

sentences.en: And they found that in middle school, dragon kids did better than their peers.
sentences.zh: 他们发现，在初中阶段，龙宝宝的表现优于同龄人。

sentences.en: They actually have higher test scores in middle school.
sentences.zh: 他们在初中的考试成绩实际上更高。

sentences.en: These kids also outperformed their peers in high school.
sentences.zh: 这些孩子在高中也优于同龄人。

sentences.en: Even at this standardized nationwide university entrance exams, dragon kids score better.
sentences.zh: 即使在标准化的全国大学入学考试中，龙宝宝的得分也更高。

sentences.en: And they did better in college.
sentences.zh: 而且他们在大学里表现得更好。

sentences.en: Individuals who were born in the year of the dragon,
sentences.zh: 出生在龙年的人，

sentences.en: they are 14% more likely to have earned at least a bachelor's degree.
sentences.zh: 他们获得至少学士学位的可能性高出14%。

sentences.en: This was not the outcome that the economists expected to find.
sentences.zh: 这并不是经济学家预期的结果。

sentences.en: Yes, it was really unexpected, frankly.
sentences.zh: 是的，坦率地说，这真的很出乎意料。

sentences.en: At first, Najee and Han came up with a straightforward explanation.
sentences.zh: 起初，纳吉和韩提出了一个简单的解释。

sentences.en: Middle and high school teachers in China probably also believe in the Zodiac.
sentences.zh: 中国的初高中老师可能也相信生肖。

sentences.en: They were just granting high grades to dragon kids.
sentences.zh: 他们只是在给龙宝宝打高分。

sentences.en: But that account fell apart because college-level entrance exams are graded by a computer,
sentences.zh: 但这种说法站不住脚，因为大学入学考试是由计算机评分的，

sentences.en: not by a superstitious human being.
sentences.zh: 而不是由迷信的人类评分的。

sentences.en: Also, dragon kids were outperforming peers in the same classroom.
sentences.zh: 此外，属龙的孩子在同一个教室里表现也优于同龄人。

sentences.en: Kids who were born right before and right after the auspicious year.
sentences.zh: 那些在吉祥年份前后出生的小孩。

sentences.en: According to our results, it seems that when dragons compared with other Zodiacs,
sentences.zh: 根据我们的研究结果，似乎当属龙的人与其他生肖相比时，

sentences.en: on average, they are really doing better.
sentences.zh: 平均而言，他们的表现确实更好。

sentences.en: Okay, dragon kids were doing better because they had higher self-esteem.
sentences.zh: 好的，属龙的孩子表现更好，是因为他们有更高的自尊心。

sentences.en: So if everybody tells them, oh, you are superior, you are smarter than everybody,
sentences.zh: 所以如果每个人都告诉他们，哦，你很优秀，你比别人更聪明，

sentences.en: you are destined for greatness and good fortune,
sentences.zh: 你注定会成就伟大和好运，

sentences.en: you know, they may believe that this is the case in their self-esteem.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们可能会在自尊心上相信事实确实如此。

sentences.en: You know, we know that from other research that self-esteem is important in learning people,
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们从其他研究中得知，自尊心对学习者很重要，

sentences.en: kids who have more self-esteem, they do better in school.
sentences.zh: 自尊心更强的孩子，在学校表现更好。

sentences.en: But when they looked at how children reported their own beliefs about their IQ,
sentences.zh: 但当他们观察孩子们如何报告自己对智商的看法时，

sentences.en: there was no difference between dragon kids and kids born right before and right afterwards.
sentences.zh: 属龙的孩子和在他们前后出生的小孩之间并没有区别。

sentences.en: And dragon kids are not more confident about their own abilities or about their own future.
sentences.zh: 属龙的孩子对自己的能力或未来并没有更自信。

sentences.en: In fact, the dragon kids weren't really smarter.
sentences.zh: 事实上，属龙的孩子并没有真的更聪明。

sentences.en: They scored the same on IQ tests.
sentences.zh: 他们在智商测试中的得分是一样的。

sentences.en: So what explained their success at school?
sentences.zh: 那么是什么解释了他们在学校的成功呢？

sentences.en: Yeah, it's just the software.
sentences.zh: 是的，这只是软件问题。

sentences.en: Basically, every Chinese use this, uses this thing.
sentences.zh: 基本上，每个中国人都用这个，用这个东西。

sentences.en: From his office at Louisiana State University, Han Yu calls his parents in China.
sentences.zh: 韩宇在路易斯安那州立大学的办公室里，给他在中国的父母打电话。

sentences.en: It turns out, the success of dragon babies doesn't lie with the schools
sentences.zh: 事实证明，龙宝宝的成功并不在于学校，

sentences.en: or the teachers or even with the kids themselves.
sentences.zh: 也不在于老师，甚至不在于孩子自己。

sentences.en: It's because of parents like Shaoqi and Yangsheng.
sentences.zh: 这是因为像邵奇和杨胜这样的父母。

sentences.en: From the moment Han was born, his parents had sky-high expectations for him.
sentences.zh: 从韩出生的那一刻起，他的父母就对他寄予了极高的期望。

sentences.en: That turns out to be the case with many parents of dragon babies.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，许多龙宝宝的父母都是这样。

sentences.en: The parents of these dragon children, they are actually more likely to believe,
sentences.zh: 这些龙孩子的父母，实际上更有可能相信，

sentences.en: in comparison to other parents,
